name: Circle
summary: Community platform for creator businesses: discussions, courses, events, memberships and messaging in one branded home — plus a no-code website builder, branded iOS/Android apps, email marketing, a member CRM, built-in payments and AI agents that answer member questions.
best_for: creators and brands running a paid community — courses, memberships, events and discussions in one branded home, with a built-in payments stack and even branded mobile apps
skip_if: you only need a casual chat space (Discord-style) or your margins are thin on high sales volume — the platform commission plus processing fees stack against you
honest_knock: The sticker is only the entry: Circle keeps a commission on every sale on top of Stripe's processing fees, and email marketing is a separate add-on — so a monetized community's real bill runs meaningfully past the plan price. Model it at your actual sales volume before choosing a tier.

pricing.notes: (2026) Professional about $89/mo billed annually ($129 monthly), Business $199/mo annual, Scale $419/mo annual, plus a custom Circle Plus tier for fully branded apps. On top of the subscription Circle takes a commission on every sale you make through the platform (roughly 2% on Professional, 1% on Business, 0.5% on Plus) plus standard Stripe/PayPal processing, and the Email Hub is a paid add-on around $99/mo for 10,000 contacts. 14-day free trial, but no always-free option. Re-verified 12 October 2026 on circle.so/pricing and its pricing.md: Professional $89, Business $199 and Scale $419 a month, all marked as annual-billing USD prices excluding tax, Circle Plus on custom pricing; transaction fees 2%, 1%, 1% and 0.5%; Circle AI credits 2,500, 2,500 and 5,000 a month, extra credits $10 per 1,000; Business includes 5,000 Admin API requests a month ($.005 per extra request), Scale 30,000 ($.002). The $129 monthly figure is not printed on the page we read.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 31 October 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We set up the community, looked at the audience and the contact import, and opened the plan checkout.
findings: Setup asks four questions, including your annual revenue. The trial ran to 14 November, with no card.
In the audience list the admin account itself was set to receive marketing emails ('Yes').
The contact import has its own marketing switch, off by default, with the note to enable it only with explicit consent.
The upload area for the CSV did not accept our file in this test, so the import was not done. We count that as a limit of our test setup, not of Circle.
Professional was preselected at $89 a month billed yearly, or $129 monthly. The yearly checkout showed $1,068 due today, with no tax line.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
